patterns.note: Centered content blocks with full-width, gradient-infused hero and footer sections, creating a balanced and spacious feel.
Elegant serif for primary headings, clean sans-serif for body and subheadings, and monospaced for small labels and metadata, establishing a sophisticated hierarchy.
Soft, ethereal gradient backgrounds in the hero and footer sections, contrasting with a predominantly white main background and dark text for clarity.
Sections reveal with a staggered fade-up and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, creating a sense of unfolding content.
The hero features a subtle parallax effect on the central 3D model and continuously rotating abstract elements around it, adding depth and dynamism.
Card-like containers with a frosted glass background effect are used for key information blocks and calls to action, particularly in the footer, adding a modern, translucent aesthetic.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered section reveals are implemented using a staggered fade-in and subtle upward translation for elements as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated with GSAP ScrollTrigger.

The hero section employs a dynamic, animated gradient background and a sophisticated 3D-rendered model with subtle lighting effects, suggesting the use of WebGL/Three.js or canvas for real-time visual richness.
Interactive UI elements, such as buttons and input fields, feature subtle hover states that involve color shifts and slight scaling, enhancing user engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous letter spacing, complemented by clean sans-serif body text and very small, uppercase monospaced labels.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded (subtle to moderate, consistently applied to buttons, cards, and image corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical and horizontal padding, creating a sense of spaciousness, especially in the hero and between major sections).

standout: The distinctive blend of high-tech visuals (3D model, animated gradients) with a soft, ethereal, and luxurious aesthetic, particularly the use of frosted glass elements and elegant typography. It feels like a high-end beauty brand meeting cutting-edge AI, creating a unique 'luxe tech' identity.
